full_judgment: 3. The short facts of this Rule are as follows: the respondent No. 2 along with others instituted Arpita Sampati Partapan Case before the Tribunal without impleading the petitioner, who is in possession over the suit property. The case of the plaintiff alleging inter-alia that the suit property measuring 3.39 acres of land originally belonged to Radha Nath Das and Hori Nath Das. After demise of Hari Nath Das, his sister Annanda Sundari transferred the suit property to the plaintiffs and Gopendra Narayan Das by a Will dated 8-2-1975. The plaintiff got probate certificate. Radha Nath Das orally gifted his portion to Gopendra Narayan and Annanda Sundari and accordingly MRR Khatian 528 was recorded. Plaintiffs, being in possession over the suit property, were constrained to institute the suit.
